### Research Projects

#### Gaussian Processes for Non-Concurrent Controls in Platform Trials

- Investigated statistical borrowing from non-concurrent controls in platform trials under the Entire Concurrently Eligible (ECE) framework.
- Compared single-task and multi-task Gaussian process models for modeling temporal heterogeneity and improving estimation efficiency.

#### Statistical Evaluation of LLM Accuracy and Stability

- Designed factorial experiments to evaluate the effects of prompt structure and sampling temperature on LLM accuracy and reproducibility.
- Applied logistic regression and entropy-based measures to assess predictive performance and response consistency.

#### Bootstrap and Jackknife+ Conformal Prediction

- Developed regression models and evaluated uncertainty using bootstrap confidence intervals.
- Implemented Jackknife+ conformal prediction to construct prediction intervals with nominal 95% coverage.
